faq: Wix or Wix Studio, which should I choose?
Wix suits most small businesses and is easier to edit yourself. Wix Studio gives designers more layout control. Tell us about your site and we recommend one, then build it in whichever you pick.
Do you need my Wix password?
No. You invite us as a collaborator from your site's roles and permissions. We do not ask for your password, and you can remove us at any time.
Who pays for the Wix plan and domain?
You do, directly to Wix. A Premium plan is needed to connect a custom domain and take payments. We build while the site is on the free plan and you upgrade when you are ready to publish.
Can you write the text for my pages?
We place the text you send and tidy it. If you have nothing yet, give us a short brief and we draft simple page copy for you to approve. It is a first draft, not a full copywriting project.
desc:
A Wix website build for your business gives you a finished site in your own Wix account, with pages, a contact form and bookings if you need them. Ecom Swift LLC builds on Wix or Wix Studio and hands it over with an editing guide.

## What is a Wix website build?

A Wix website build is the full creation of a new site: choosing the structure, designing the pages, writing or placing your content, setting up forms and booking, and connecting your domain. We start from a template you like or from a blank canvas, in your own account, so the site belongs to you from the first day.

You can pick Wix or Wix Studio. Wix suits most small businesses and is quick to edit. Wix Studio gives finer layout control and suits sites with more custom design needs. We help you decide before we begin.

## Why does a business need a properly built site?

Customers look you up before they call. A site that is missing, outdated or hard to use on a phone sends them elsewhere. A site with no clear services page, no contact form and no sign of how to book leaves visitors guessing.

Building a site yourself is possible, but the time adds up: structure, wording, mobile layout, forms, titles and domain. A professional build puts those pieces in the right order from the start, so you do not need to redo them after launch.

## How a well-built site helps you win enquiries and bookings

A good site makes three things easy: understanding what you offer, trusting that you are real and taking the next step. Pages written around your services answer the questions customers have. A visible contact form and booking button shorten the path from interest to enquiry.

With Wix Bookings, visitors can pick a service and time without calling. Page titles and descriptions help search engines show the right page for the right search. Google Analytics shows which pages bring action. We cannot promise a set number of customers, because that also depends on your market and promotion, but a clear, working site gives your marketing something solid to point to.

## What a complete Wix site includes

- A page structure planned around your services and customer questions.
- Brand styling from your logo carried through every page in the same way.
- Pages written or arranged with your own text and photos.
- A contact form that sends to your inbox and has been tested.
- Wix Bookings with services, durations and availability, or a simple enquiry flow.
- A mobile layout checked page by page.
- Page titles and descriptions for each key page.
- A blog set up if you plan to publish updates.
- Google Analytics connected so you can see visits and actions.
- Domain connection help and a short editing guide.

## What we do

We begin with a short brief covering your services, audience and examples of sites you like. We then build the structure and pages in your Wix account, add your content, set up forms and bookings, and tidy the mobile view. You review a preview and request changes before anything goes live. After approval, we help connect your domain.

The Basic package builds a small site of a few pages with branding, a contact form and domain help. The Standard package builds more pages with Wix Bookings, a blog, page titles and analytics. The Premium package delivers a complete site with up to fifteen pages, a larger booking setup, a members area or client login, custom sections and animations, a speed and mobile review, an editing walkthrough and a period of fixes afterward. An online store basics add-on is available.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Decide the one action you want most visitors to take.
- Gather your logo, photos and text before the build begins.
- List your services and what makes each one different.
- Check the preview on a phone before approving.
- Decide in advance who takes care of edits once the site is live.

**Avoid:**
- Putting every service on the home page.
- Using photos that are small or blurry.
- Copying text from competitors.
- Leaving booking details vague or out of date.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A new business that needs a first website for its services.
- A therapist, trainer or salon owner who wants customers to book online.
- A business replacing a site that is outdated or hard to edit.
- A freelancer who wants a clean portfolio and contact page quickly.

## What we need from you

Send a short description of your business, your services, your logo and any photos or text you already have. Tell us which sites you like and who will pay for the Wix plan and domain. You pay Wix and your domain registrar directly, and our price covers the work only. Add us as a collaborator or team member. We never need your password, and we can write page text with you if you prefer.
